subject: QuellTech vendor activation — invoice intake format and portal/email fallback
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena@quelltech.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: QuellTech vendor activation — invoice intake format and portal/email fallback

Hi Lena —

Congrats on getting the vendor profile created in our onboarding system. A quick question as we wire up QuellTech in AP: what will be your preferred invoice submission channel once you go live? Two things we need to confirm so our Billing team can set up matching rules: 

1) Do you plan to use our supplier portal (recommended) or continue sending invoices by email to procure@redwood.com? Either is fine — we just need the expected filename/subject conventions so automated matching works.
2) How do you want to handle invoices that apply to multiple POs? Our portal can accept a CSV with line items or a single PDF with multiple invoice pages; email fallback needs a subject convention for PO pairing.

Also: VAT and tax ID fields — do your invoices include VAT per-line or as a single tax line? And do you have a preferred remittance file format (CSV bank remittance, or plain PDF with banking details)?

If it helps, I attached a short guidance doc that shows the portal CSV schema and a preferred email subject template. Can you take a look and confirm?

Thanks —
Kimberly Park
Procurement Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com
(Attachment: Redwood_invoice_guidance_v1.docx)

From: Lena Ortiz <lena@quelltech.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procure@quelltech.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2026 12:03:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: QuellTech vendor activation — invoice intake format and portal/email fallback

Hi Kimberly —

Thanks — excited to start. A few answers below: 

- Portal is our preference for recurring invoices (monthly statements), but our finance ops team still sends supplier invoices by email for ad-hoc charges and expenses during the transition.
- For multi-PO bills, we typically send one consolidated PDF that contains individual invoice headers on each page (PO referenced on each page). We can also produce a CSV export from our ERP (couple of examples attached).
- VAT: QuellTech lists VAT on a per-line basis and includes a tax summary at the invoice footer. We include our VAT reg number on the header.
- Remittance: CSV bank remittance is available; we can provide the format if you prefer.

Attaching a sample invoice and a simple CSV export. For email fallbacks, we use the subject convention: Invoice | PO:<PO#> | QTECH-INV-<internal>. If Redwood can accept that pattern for automatic PO extraction, great.

Hope this helps —
Lena Ortiz
Finance Ops Lead
QuellTech, Inc.
lena@quelltech.com
(Attachments: QuellTech_sample_invoice.pdf, QTECH_export_sample.csv)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Lena Ortiz <lena@quelltech.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2026 10:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: QuellTech vendor activation — invoice intake format and portal/email fallback

Thanks Lena — this is helpful. A couple of clarifications from Redwood Billing: 

- We can accept a single PDF with multiple invoices (each page has its own invoice header) and our parser will attempt PO extraction from each page. PDF is fine as long as each invoice page includes the PO and invoice number in the header.
- For email fallback, please use the subject pattern you suggested but add a short prefix: Redwood Invoice — PO:<PO#> — QTECH-INV-<id>. The prefix "Redwood Invoice" helps our triage mailbox rule.
- If you submit CSV via the portal, please follow the schema in the attached doc. Required fields: po_number, invoice_number, invoice_date, line_description, line_amount, tax_amount, currency. Optional: remit_bank_iban, remit_bank_swift.

Action items: 
- Lena: if you can, resend the sample CSV with one row that includes remit_bank_iban and SWIFT so we can test remittance import.
- Kimberly / Vanessa: we'll add QuellTech to the portal whitelist and configure the auto-match rule to prefer exact PO+amount match, then fall back to invoice_number if needed.

Jordan Blake
Billing Operations
Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.com
(Attachment: none)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena@quelltech.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Apr 2026 16:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: QuellTech vendor activation — invoice intake format and portal/email fallback

Perfect — thanks everyone. Two final items before go-live: 

1) Filename/Subject conventions we will enforce for email-only invoices: 
   - Subject: Redwood Invoice — PO:<PO#> — QTECH-INV-<vendor_invoice_number>
   - File name: QTECH_<vendor_invoice_number>_PO<PO#>.pdf (helps manual review if parsing fails)

2) Exceptions / manual handling: 
   - If a single PDF contains invoices for more than one legal entity (multiple POs under different Redwood entities), please split into separate files or include the target Redwood entity in the header (we can accept a one-line mapping at top of the PDF).

Next steps: Vanessa will coordinate portal onboarding and send an invite to your AP users; Jordan will create a test mailbox and a small batch test to validate CSV remittance import. Lena — if you can resend the CSV with IBAN/SWIFT and the sample PDF named per the convention, we'll schedule the test for Friday.

Thanks —
Kimberly Park
Procurement Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
